segments.transcript: Michael (film): I need you to fire Joseph.
Lawyer (film): You're gonna fire your dad.
Lawyer (film): How would you like me to do that?
[interviewer: Do you think your father was too strict?] Michael 1979: Yes. ... No, he's going to kill me.
Joe (film): The boy fired me with a piece of paper. A piece of paper, couldn't even be man to man, huh? Look me in the eye and do it.
Piers Morgan (CNN 2013): But do you have any regrets that you may have been a little bit too tough on some of them?
Joe Jackson (CNN 2013): I'm glad I was tough, because look what I came out with.
Joe (film): What kind of son does that?
Joe (film): you got a lot to learn about family.
Michael 1979: Well, he feels that he was strict. I'm glad he said it. Now I'll say it, yes.
